AUTHOR: Levy
TITLE: Automated Analysis of Marine Video With Limited Data
REGION: Underwater data: not stated (Labeled Fishes in the Wild + AFSC); aerial data: Mediterranean coast, Israel
SPECIES: Underwater: generic 'Fish' class; aerial (above-water, not coded): shark, ray, diver
DATA: Labeled Fishes in the Wild subset (463 re-annotated) + 45 AFSC challenge images; own UAV aerial dataset (separate)
V_EV: Section 5.1: 'The dataset contains challenging images with low visibility, different scales, and cluttered background (examples in Figs. 1,2).'
D2: 448 train / 60 validation images (method unspecified); 42 independent test images from videos not used in training
D_EV: Section 5.2: 'These images did not participate in the training (neither in the validation set) and were not taken from videos of which frames were taken to the training set.'
R_EV: Fig. 10: 'The underwater test examples are different than the training images by several factors: fish species, water color, lighting conditions and scale.'
C_EV: Section 5.2: 'In the evaluation we consider only detections that have a confidence level above 0.4.'
E_EV: Section 5.2: 'For the Fish class in the fish dataset it was 0.74.' (only average precision reported; counting/sizing claimed but not quantified)
METR: Average precision per class (qualitative comparison vs YOLO)
NOTE: Paper has an underwater fish dataset and an above-water UAV shark/ray dataset; coding refers to the underwater part. NIMG = 463+45 train/val + 42 test underwater images. Train/val split (448/60) unit not stated; independent test set explicitly from videos not in training -> D1 coded 영상(video). R1=Y: qualitative generalization to images differing in species, water color, lighting (Fig. 10), no numeric performance -> R3=N. V3=Y because generalization set described as 'taken with artificial illumination assistance'. C_ALL is a rule gap: threshold 0.4 (non-default) with false-positive discussion (Fig. 8) but no threshold sensitivity, no C5; coded P by analogy to 'C1=Y alone -> P', could be N. SORT tracking is used to link detections for counting but no ID-switch/duplicate-count evaluation -> C5 없음. Platform/environment of Labeled Fishes in the Wild (NOAA ROV, rockfish) not stated in paper -> NR.
